column8: Return leg of the swap above.
Same link, return direction. No contract supports it: candidate for closure.
Sangtuda-Kunduz 220 kV, existing PPA, 188 MW all year.
CASA-1000 DC link Sangtuda-Nowshera, 1000 MW. The 2020 file carried 1300 MW, which is the rating of the whole link including the Afghan tap.
Directions swapped back: the 2020 file capped this way at 80 MW while pMaxAnnualTransfer requires 2100 GWh/y through it.
May-September window: 188 MW PPA + 150 MW seasonal + 300 MW CASA-1000 Afghan tap = 638 MW.
